newsitem.title: USA: Paraguay eyes air cargo port for Mercosur.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay eyes air cargo port for Mercosur.

text.p: Paraguay is planning to build a special cargo facility at one of its biggest airports to act as a cargo center for the Mercosur countries, a top government official said on Wednesday.

Mercosur "led my government to think and has given more dynamism to our airports," said Roberto Yorki, an official of Paraguay's civil aviation administration. Paraguay is now planning a cargo and maintenance facility to serve the Mercosur countries, he said.
Investment bankers at the conference said several countries were discussing developing Mercosur air cargo centers, but Paraguay seemed to be the furthest along.

Proparaguay, the investment promotion agency of the Paraguayan government, expects to open bids before the end of the month, according to documents circulated at the Americas Conference on Aviation, sponsored by the Federal Aviation Administration, the Dade County Aviation Department and others.

Paraguayan officials are still studying whether the cargo port should be attached to the airport in Cuidad del Este or Asuncion, according to the documents prepared by aviation consultants Montgomery Consulting Group, Inc. Maitland, Florida.

The cost for the first phase of the regional cargo port is expected to be $45 million. The cargo port is expected to be financed by a combination of public and private funds, according to the documents.
